status_gate.criterion: WFA completes with at least 30 windows and 200 total trades

robustness_assessment.verdict: Parameters show PARTIAL robustness but NOT fully robust. The 61.1% positive Sharpe rate is below the 70% threshold, suggesting partial overfitting to original training windows. However, aggregate Sharpe 0.664 and max DD -9.16% indicate some genuine edge exists.

comparison_to_prior_run.interpretation: The ~48% Sharpe decline when running FIXED parameters across multiple windows vs single optimized window confirms some degree of overfitting. However, Sharpe 0.664 and 61.1% positive windows indicate the parameters are not completely arbitrary - there is genuine signal, but the original 1.275 was likely partially lucky.

hypothesis_test.hypothesis: Parameters will maintain Sharpe > 0.8 and Drawdown < 15% across at least 70% of WFA windows
hypothesis_test.partial_confirmation: Max DD criterion met; Sharpe and positive window % criteria NOT met

recommendations: The discovered BNB parameters (rsi_oversold=25, rsi_overbought=60, hold_bars=168) show partial robustness but NOT full robustness
Consider: (1) More conservative parameter deployment - reduce position size, (2) Additional out-of-sample validation, (3) Ensemble with other signals
The ~48% Sharpe decline (1.275 -> 0.664) when tested across multiple windows confirms significant overfitting
Max DD -9.16% is acceptable for live deployment with appropriate position sizing
